name: What are the essential features for an accessible aging-in-place bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the essential features for an accessible aging-in-place bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential features for an accessible aging-in-place bathroom often include a curbless or low-threshold shower, grab bars strategically placed near the toilet and in the shower, and a comfort-height toilet. Wider doorways and clear floor space for maneuverability are also crucial. AKN Design Group focuses on integrating these elements seamlessly, ensuring they complement the bathroom's overall design. Our design-build process ensures these functional elements are not just additions, but integral parts of a cohesive, spa-inspired space that enhances both safety and luxury.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential features include curbless showers, grab bars, comfort-height toilets, and wider doorways, seamlessly integrated for safety and aesthetics.
